headline: Management for athletes and influencers
intro: Black Meridian Management accompanies athletes and influencers on their career path. We look for suitable sponsors and brand partners, negotiate conditions and take care of the collaboration. We develop advertising campaigns for companies with talent that fits their brand and their target group.
imageNote: Editorial imagery. People pictured are not confirmed talents of the agency.
aboutText: Behind every career there is a person with their own goals. We create space for what defines you - and take care of the partnerships that take you forward.
aboutDetail: On the field, in front of the camera and in crucial conversations: We combine personal support with a clear view of your future.
serviceTitle: You focus on your talent. Let's take care of the rest.
s1Text: Career planning, contacting sponsors, media inquiries and appearances. Always tailored to your training and competition calendar.
s2Text: Appropriate brands, fair fees and clear usage rights. We coordinate briefings, releases and publications.
s3Text: Partnerships that suit both sides. From seasonal sponsorship to long-term collaboration.
s4Text: From the first idea to publication. We develop and coordinate campaigns with suitable talent.
talentTitle: Exceptional. In your own unique way.
talentText: Sports and content. Different worlds, one common goal: making a difference.
emptyText: Our talent profiles are currently being prepared. Verified profiles and shared images follow. Would you like to become part of our journey?
brandTitle: The right personality. For your brand.
brandText: We bring companies together with athletes and influencers who fit their target group and their values. With a clear briefing, personal coordination and well-thought-out implementation.
step1Text: Define goals, target group and general conditions together.
step2Text: Align talent and ideas with your brand.
contactTitle: Great things begin with a conversation.
contactText: Tell us what you're up to. We look forward to getting to know you.
